items.title: PODCAST: Pacers outwork, outrebound Knicks in NBA Cup win
items.body_excerpt: On this episode of the Fieldhouse Files… the Pacers (5-8) picked up a 106-104 NBA Cup win over the New York Knicks with hard play, paint dominance, and a needed jolt from the bench unit. They got contributions from everybody who played, and held off a late push by the Knicks…
